# Blender Add-on Development

Write Blender add-ons as extensions: start from a bundled template (manifest, operators, panel, preferences), follow the Blender 5.x rules for bpy.props, undo, modal and timer patterns and gpu drawing, bundle Python wheels instead of pip installs, then validate, build and test the extension headless with the Blender CLI before publishing.
